title: Home Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Home Condition Inspection: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Home Inspection Checklist covers visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern. The home inspection coordinator records Home Condition Inspection criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Home Inspection Checklist keeps Home Condition Inspection exceptions visible until the home inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Home Inspection Checklist at residence exterior, interior, accessible attic, visible foundation, and installed systems. Document visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern identity before Home Condition Inspection begins. Compare visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern findings with stated Home Condition Inspection criteria; route unresolved Home Condition Inspection issues to qualified home-condition reviewer. For Home Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Home Condition Inspection. Ask qualified home-condition reviewer to review Home Condition Inspection conditions beyond the home inspection coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Home Condition Inspection, identify responsible parties, residence exterior, interior, accessible attic, visible foundation, and installed systems, and the linked visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern source.

fields.label: Occupancy, weather, utilities, and access status
System age or identifier when visible

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Home Condition Inspection facts for visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Home Condition Inspection checks
items: Site drainage, exterior, roof, and visible structure
Interior rooms, windows, doors, stairs, and finishes
Electrical, plumbing, heating, cooling, and installed equipment
Attic, insulation, ventilation, and moisture indication
Visible foundation, crawlspace, basement, and drainage
Limitations, inaccessible areas, and specialist referral triggers

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Home Condition Inspection finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Home Inspection Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Active electrical, fuel, structural, or water hazard
Specialist evaluation or immediate protection needed
Operating observation and measurement where appropriate
blocks.guidance: Pause Home Condition Inspection when a safety hazard, access limitation, active damage, or required specialist escalation remains uncommunicated. Retain the available Home Condition Inspection proof and route unresolved visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern scope to home inspection coordinator.
